name: WorkflowTasks
description: Represents a collection of WorkflowTask objects.
example:
Sub DisplayWorkTask()
Dim objWorkflowTasks As WorkflowTasks
Dim objWorkflowTask As WorkflowTask
Dim cnt As Integer

Set objWorkflowTasks = Document.GetWorkflowTasks()

For cnt = 1 To objWorkflowTasks.Count
 Debug.Print objWorkflowTask(cnt).Name
Next

Set objWorkflowTask = objWorkflowTasks(1)
objWorkflowTask.Show

End Sub

properties.name: Application
properties.description: Gets an Application object that represents the container application for the WorkflowTasks object. Read-only.

properties.name: Creator
properties.description: Gets a 32-bit integer that indicates the application in which the WorkflowTasks object was created. Read-only.

properties.name: Item
properties.description: Gets a WorkflowTask object from the WorkflowTasks collection. Read-only.

properties.name: Count
properties.description: Gets a Long indicating the number of items in the WorkflowTasks collection. Read-only.
